Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning. Quick recap: you said top priorities are predictable latency for short prompts, token-cost visibility per route, and an SSO/KMS integration for auditability. I pulled together a 20-minute demo agenda focused on the latency profile for your use case and a short mutual action plan attached.

We had a scheduled deep-dive for today that looks like it missed in calendar — totally understand things come up. To keep momentum I can offer two final slots this week; both are compact and will include one of our inference engineers:

- Thu Jul 22 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Fri Jul 23 — 01:00–01:30 PM PT

If one of those works, please reply with a simple “Yes — I’ll take Thu/Fri” (pick one) and I’ll send the calendar invite and meeting link. If I don’t hear back within 24 hours I’ll assume you want to pause and will release the slots.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Short ask / next step: confirm the slot or propose one concrete alternative (date + time + timezone).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars quickly.

— Mina
